[page 3] Testing (1) ➢ A test is performed when a decision about a population must be made. Example. A juice company claims that its bottles contain 16 ounces of juice. We take a sample of 64 bottles and calculate the sample mean to be 15.8 ounces. Can we state that the bottles contain less?
[page 10] Testing (8) A juice company claims that its bottles contain 16 ounces of juice. We take a sample of 64 bottles and calculate the sample mean to be 15.8 ounces. It is known that the standard deviation is 0.8 ounces. Example worked out: H o : μ = 16 H a : μ < 16
[page 11] Testing (9) Example 2 Harbor Paper Mill cuts sheets that are supposed to be 11 inches long. We take a sample of 100 sheets and calculate the sample mean to be 11.02 inches. What type of hypothesis test is this? Left - tailed Right - tailed Two - tailed What is (are) the critical value(s) of z ? Sketch the rejection region. Make a decision about H o
[page 12] Testing: Proportions (10) Example 3 A survey reported that 30% of commuters ride a bike. A city planner claims the share is now higher. She asks 400 commuters and finds 34% ride. What type of hypothesis test is this? Left - tailed Right - tailed Two - tailed What is (are) the critical value(s) of z ? Sketch the rejection region. Make a decision about H o
[page 13] Testing: Proportions (11) Example 4 A bakery says at most 5% of its rolls are misshapen. Quality control inspects 100 rolls and finds 9 misshapen ones. What type of hypothesis test is this? Left - tailed Right - tailed Two - tailed What is (are) the critical value(s) of z ? Sketch the rejection region. Make a decision about H o
